scope_binding.derive_from: authenticated principal: chat session (session.pool) or agent principal token; never request body

on_mismatch.side_effects: none: no job, no outbox, no dedupe lookup across scopes

scope_binding.persist: store derived values; envelope.access is kept only as an audited copy that already equals derived

idempotency.payload_hash: sha256 hex of UTF-8 JCS bytes of the envelope after removing excluded paths
idempotency.included: every other field, including envelope_id, producer, access (already bound), source, rights, raw, normalized, quality, fact_check_status, dedupe, decision, errors, lineage, extensions

same_key_same_hash.body: existing job id, no new rows
